statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let K := fun (X p q : ℕ) => ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ q≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p) ∧ Nat.Prime (n-q))).card; let S := fun d : ℕ => ∏ l ∈ d.primeFactors.filter (fun l => 2 < l), (((l:ℝ)-1)/((l:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ p ∈ P X, ∀ q ∈ P X, p < q → (K X p q:ℝ) ≤ C*(X:ℝ)*S (q-p)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 统一控制两个小素数平移的共同邻点
plain_statement.en: Sieve the shared neighbors of two distinct small primes

brief.zh: 在长区间对 n−p,n−q 作二维上界筛。区分整除位移的素数，常数须对 p,q 一致。
brief.en: Use an upper-bound sieve for two linear forms, separating primes dividing the shift and tracking uniform constants.
